import json, os
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in __import__('re').finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=[k for k in c if k!=bg]
    marker=marker[0] if marker else bg
    return [[marker if v==bg else 0 for v in r] for r in grid]

di,do_=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(transform(di)==do_)
out=transform(G['Test input'])
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/out.json','w'))
print(json.dumps(out))
